evaluation.overall_comment:
The translation is highly competent and successfully bridges a complex physics dialogue into Macedonian. It demonstrates strong technical accuracy, preserves the conversational podcast format, and conveys all scientific concepts clearly. Minor issues stem from a few calques ('ингенозност', 'непомирлива') and slight notational awkwardness, which prevent a flawless score but do not detract significantly from the overall quality or comprehensibility of the text.
